title: Comic Project, Page, Panel & Layer Schema
objective: Define stable comic project, page, panel and layer identity; governed ARI resource references; transform state; text elements; and output metadata without embedding source assets by default.
acceptance: Project, page, panel and layer records have stable identities and deterministic serializable structure.
Composition references governed ARI resources by stable reference rather than duplicating source assets by default.
Layer schema carries presentation transform state without mutating Character, Scene, MAI or source-resource truth.
Text elements remain explicit text state rather than flattened-only image content.
Output metadata preserves provenance/resource lineage and does not grant publishing or redistribution rights.
Unknown or unsupported resource capabilities remain explicit rather than fabricated.
No implementation starts until a later explicit owner Continue verifies the SAA start gates.
boundaries: ARI remains resource/provenance authority and source assets are referenced rather than privately duplicated by default.
Character/CAPP/PAPT appearance, MAI/Scene spatial truth and Story/CSW narrative truth remain with their owners.
Rights filtering must precede requested transform/export/share operations.
AI remains proposal-only and cannot silently author canonical state.
SAA selection is a control-plane successor seed only; this checkpoint grants no implementation authority.
next_action: Await a later explicit owner Continue. Then verify SAA start gates and governed-start SAA-01; do not start from this closeout.
